title: Expected squared Fourier coefficient under a random restriction
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on n variables
sum over all restrictions ρ weighted by the Bernoulli weight w_p(ρ)
right-hand sum over all U ⊆ [n], with summand 0 unless S ⊆ U
replaced:
Under a Bernoulli($p$)-random restriction $\rho$, the expected squared Fourier
coefficient at $S$ is
\[
  \E_\rho\bigl[\widehat{f_\rho}(S)^2\bigr] \;=\; \sum_{U \supseteq S}
  p^{\abs{S}}\,(1-p)^{\abs{U \setminus S}}\cdot \widehat{f}(U)^2,
\]
where the sum runs over all $U \subseteq [n]$ and the terms with $S \not\subseteq U$
vanish.
